title: スプリンターズSの後に・カワイイ！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan conquers the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She smiles, looking extremely satisfied as the packed racecourse lovingly chants, "Cute Curren Chan!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan's followers increase tenfold. She becomes the number one trending topic worldwide and gets an unbelievable number of likes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is how Curren Chan becomes the most beloved runner in the world, both in name and in reality. Next, she wonders who it is that loves her most of all…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Juuust kidding! I know it's you!" She shoots me an irresistibly cute smile.
